title: GatherEvidenceInput
description: Input for the gather-evidence skill: the seed papers for one cell type, the query decomposition that defines relevance, and the traversal limits. Seeds are searched in priority order; each is routed independently (JATS whole-text first, ASTA snippets as fallback) by cli_annotate route/read.

seeds.description: Hop-0 papers in priority order: the paper that defines the cell type first (subatlas_primary where subatlas_contributors says so), then the atlas paper.

reason.description: Why this seed is here (e.g. 'subatlas_primary per subatlas_consistency.json').

decomposition_path.description: Path to this cell type's query_decomposition.json (aspects, aliases, scope, combined_query).

depth.description: Citation hops to follow from each seed (0 = seeds only).

k_per_paper.description: Max references followed per paper per hop (hub-paper safety cap, not the relevance filter).

run_cap.description: Max distinct papers processed across the whole run.

reader_model.description: Model pinned on every reader subagent dispatch. Recorded per job in reader_provenance.json so runs under different settings stay comparable.

project_dir.description: Project root — the JATS cache and ASTA band cache live here.

output_dir.description: Traversal output directory for this cell type.
